status: Design recommendation only. No runtime files or generator were changed.
main_recommendation: Build a visible three-way regime fork whose implemented outcomes replace one national spirit. Separate constitutional rule, active coercion, unresolved abuses and professional command. The following numbers are gameplay proposals, not measured historical statistics.

md_observations.lesson: Upgrade one spirit instead of adding another permanent PP package.
Second explicit replacement stage.
A major administrative choice is a visible focus fork.
Real mixed package: authority and tax yield with recurring administration costs. Do not copy the large flat cost.
The alternative changes the economic profile instead of giving every option the same reward.

political_power_factor.unit: Fractional relative PP gain; +0.12 means +12%, not +12 PP/day.

bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier.unit: Relative recurring bureaucracy spending; positive is a cost.

police_cost_multiplier_modifier.unit: Relative recurring police spending; positive is a cost.

army_org_factor.unit: Relative organisation; does not create units or command authority.

foreign_influence_defense_modifier.unit: Resistance to foreign influence; it is not diplomatic recognition.

tax_gain_multiplier_modifier.unit: Relative tax yield; not GDP or money creation.

regime_packages.title: Rule by Decree
regime_packages.duration: Until actually replaced by another constitutional regime; not a fixed expiry.
activation_conditions: Existing January 1970 start; no new grant.
regime_packages.strategic_meaning: Baseline fast executive rule lacks legitimacy. Replaced, not retained underneath later packages.

regime_packages.title: A Consolidated Military Government
regime_packages.duration: Until actually replaced by another constitutional regime; not a fixed expiry.
activation_conditions: Actual military cabinet retains constitutional control.
The administrative compact has actually been implemented, rather than merely proposed.
regime_packages.strategic_meaning: Strongest PP profile supports rapid domestic decisions. Officer patronage adds recurring expense and the legitimacy deficit persists. Benefits belong to cabinet coordination, never torture, censorship or detention.

regime_packages.title: A Limited Constitutional Opening
regime_packages.duration: Until actually replaced by another constitutional regime; not a fixed expiry.
activation_conditions: Papadopoulos or another actual authorised government has implemented a limited civilian opening.
Civilian technocrats have actual powers; military reserve powers remain.
Opposition acceptance is recorded where a negotiated pact is claimed; refusal can leave a unilateral limited opening with no democratic-mandate reward.
regime_packages.strategic_meaning: Compromise: less legitimacy loss than military tutelage, more executive PP than full parliamentary government, with duplicated civilian/military administration costs. This is not full democracy or automatic European acceptance.

regime_packages.title: Civilian Constitutional Government
regime_packages.duration: Until actually replaced by another constitutional regime; not a fixed expiry.
activation_conditions: Actual civilian transfer of executive control.
Legal political competition and an implemented credible electoral or negotiated parliamentary mandate.
Civilian supremacy and an end to political detention/torture as state policy; individual accountability can remain unfinished.
Republic or parliamentary monarchy remains a separate valid constitutional choice.
regime_packages.strategic_meaning: Higher legitimacy supports a stable long-term society, while bargaining, oversight and competitive institutions slow unilateral executive action. No automatic army, research, construction or foreign-aid bonus.

transition_packages.title: Negotiating the Transfer of Power
transition_packages.start_when: A real transition process begins, once per implemented process.
transition_packages.ends_when: Actual settlement can remove it early. Timer expiry removes negotiation friction only, never chooses a ruler or awards civilian legitimacy.
transition_packages.failure: A rejected offer leaves the previous regime in control; it does not force a coup, election winner or foreign response.

transition_packages.title: Reorganising the Chain of Command
transition_packages.start_when: A funded, implemented restructuring of actual command appointments, not an atrocity or mere political speech.
transition_packages.ends_when: Temporary disruption expires; the actual professionalisation milestone independently determines which persistent officer spirit applies.
transition_packages.failure: No permanent organisation reward without actual reform.

active.title: Censorship, Detention and Torture
active.rule: Keep these harms explicit while the coercive practices continue under any ruler. No surveillance or torture focus grants organisation, research, productivity, XP or a PP bonus for the abusive act.

ended_but_unresolved.title: The Unresolved Security-State Legacy
ended_but_unresolved.replace: Replace security_state only after the political detention/torture apparatus has actually ceased operating and political detainees are dealt with under due process.
ended_but_unresolved.rule: Ending ongoing abuse ends its recurring police-cost burden; unresolved victims, records and responsibility remain. It need not wait for every trial to finish.

accountability.title: Accountability under Due Process
accountability.requires: Actual courts, access to records, independent oversight and a funded victim remedy process.
accountability.rule: This is a temporary real administrative cost, not a new permanent moral penalty. Completion can remove the unresolved legacy once actual conditions are met; expiry alone does not certify justice.

security_lifecycle.amnesty_alternative: A limited officer amnesty can avoid command-reorganisation disruption only for officers retained under a lawful settlement. It cannot remove the unresolved security legacy or claim the accountability package; due-process limits and grave-crime obligations must stay explicit.
security_lifecycle.path_access: A military government can stop abusive practices without becoming a democracy. A civilian ruler can fail to stop them and therefore fail the constitutional-legitimacy package. Neither label alone proves the practice changed.

starting_spirit_lifecycle.treatment: The baseline of the exclusive regime_governance slot. Every permanent regime implementation replaces it. Do not merely remove it at legal_parties while leaving no coherent successor.
Use the security lifecycle above. Accountability focus completion alone cannot prove ongoing torture stopped; stopping it does not erase the legacy.

Separate command_quality slot. Funded intermediate reform can replace with army_org_factor=-0.04,max_planning=-0.02; a full implemented professional command can remove that residual. All regimes can choose reform. Neither a civilian transfer nor ESA surveillance gives free combat efficiency.
Retain until actual rights benchmarks and the relevant foreign/institutional acceptance. Internal opening is not recognition. No forced EEC/CoE/NATO change, treaty or subsidy.

starting_spirit_lifecycle.scope: Only currently owned designated states 139, 142 and 974
starting_spirit_lifecycle.treatment: Keep outside country governance. Only paid, implemented regional development relieves it. A party, referendum or junta consolidation does not remove rural bottlenecks.

Keep outside governance. Actual audit, transparent procurement and professional recruitment can partially replace it with+0.05, then remove after verified implementation. Regime-specific patronage cost remains even if legacy clientelism is cured.
Retain under all regimes unless an actual separate economic crisis changes the foundations. Democracy does not create the existing boom, and military rule is not the sole source of Greek growth.

Remove only after a genuine constitutional settlement determines the crown's status. A junta proclamation alone does not pay the legitimate-settlement reward. A parliamentary monarchy can use civilian_constitutional_government; an executive royal regime must use the appropriate nonpluralist governance slot rather than stack both.

Military consolidation only; all other starting problems persist
Limited opening only; abusive apparatus not yet closed, all other starting problems persist

The same civilian state after genuine crown settlement and completed accountability, other problems persist

combined_table_limits: These tables exclude party programmes, advisors, laws, one-time stability effects, conditional oil/war spirits and temporary transition friction. State penalties are intentionally not added to national construction. They are not forecasts of the final displayed game totals.

graph_recommendation.junction: After state_dossier / cabinet and civilian contacts, make a visible common three-way constitutional choice: Retain Military Government / Open the Regime / Transfer to Civilian Rule.
controlled: Define the Limits of the Opening
graph_recommendation.resolve: Only implemented milestones install the appropriate exclusive regime package. An offer card may record an offer with no settlement reward.
graph_recommendation.later_change: Focus completion records history. A later actual opening, failed opening or civilian replacement can revise current regime state through a new domestic process. A permanent focus X must not globally forbid later historical change or make an externally observed coup invisible.
graph_recommendation.party_follow_through: Papadopoulos and Ioannidis keep actual person gates despite both occupying native military-junta subparty 22. ND/Centre/PASOK/KKE/royal trees require actual current power and their own historical organisation phase.
graph_recommendation.economy_in_paths: Keep paid tourism/export credit, military procurement/civilian supply, regulated competition/public enterprises, social provision/targeted rural transfers and cooperative/central planning forks in the party routes. These provide distinct economic identities and their real spending costs; no free money, allies or extra factories are needed in the constitutional fork.

generator_findings.issue: Their current institutions-slot PP/stability rewards would duplicate the proposed regime-wide authority/legitimacy package.
generator_findings.recommendation: Make the regime package own authority/legitimacy, and convert these cards into implementation/conditions or explicitly subtract their overlapping modifiers. Never install both old first-fork package and the full new regime package.

generator_findings.issue: ESA Surveillance follows the closed-circle branch carrying PP benefit. Presentation can make torture look like the action that earns authority.
generator_findings.recommendation: Label and place cabinet coordination separately from coercion. ESA surveillance exposes police costs, repression and victims; it does not grant combat efficiency, PP, XP or production for torture.

generator_findings.issue: One removal each is too coarse for a replacement regime and multi-stage security legacy.
generator_findings.recommendation: Opening parties does not alone certify civilian control. Replace active security practice only when actually ended; retain unresolved legacy until a genuine accountability or remedy outcome.

generator_findings.issue: Current one-time stability/PP grants must not pay for an unresolved proposal, an unimplemented election or a forced winner.
generator_findings.recommendation: The offer can get a small once-only dialogue reward if desired; reserve settlement payloads for actual outcomes and one payload owner. Mark direct add_stability separately from persistent stability_factor.

generator_findings.issue: Civilian or royal institutional forks may themselves change pluralism or authority. A universal civilian package must not stay enabled underneath a later one-party vanguard or executive crown.
generator_findings.recommendation: Define current constitutional regime independently of country ruler slot. Update the one regime slot after actual constitutional changes; retain only compatible policy slots and recount permanent PP/stability ceilings.

anti_stacking_and_scope_rules: One active regime_governance package. Remove every sibling before adding its selected replacement; do not rely on swapping only the original decree idea after later revisions.
One active security-practice or unresolved-legacy stage; an accountability transition can coexist only as an explicitly bounded cost.
One command-quality stage; timed reform disruption is counted separately and cannot be refreshed by repeatedly switching parties.
Government-specific economic programmes replace their shared national slots on actual government change. Completed focus history never keeps another government's enabled bonuses alive.
Do not add all seven party routes. Recompute caps for common branches plus one eligible government, its compatible regime and starting residue.

The original research/construction/organisation caps do not authorise new bonuses silently: include any new package in the cap audit. The proposed governance packages add no construction, research or army-organisation bonus.
Use once-only implementation flags/ledger for direct PP, stability, experience and compensation payloads. Re-entering a known regime does not replay those rewards.
Native swap_ideas/add_timed_idea are confirmed APIs. Proposed COLDWAR ids, regime resolver, current-regime triggers and review ledgers are NEW design contracts, not existing callable APIs.
Do not use a clock to choose Papadopoulos/Ioannidis, elect a civilian, restore the king, declare war or gain external consent.
Time-limited friction may expire safely; permanent regime status changes only after a real domestic outcome. Failed negotiation must leave a viable existing-government path.
No calendar-only coup; no torture reward; no removal of victims from the narrative; no ethnicity-based penalties.

open_findings.problem: Regime change removes every government programme idea but retains its focus_granted flag. A later lawful return cannot enable that idea because the once-only reward guard now rejects the entire payload.
open_findings.fix: Separate one-time implementation/payment from a repeatable current-programme synchronizer, or a new per-government activation ledger. Re-enable only the eligible selected programme without re-paying PP/stability/experience or charging its original construction cost again.

open_findings.problem: Common+ND maximum factory efficiency cap 0.1085 plus civilian_enterprise 0.021 equals 0.1295, exceeding the explicit 0.12 national programme budget.
open_findings.fix: Keep regime_development at 0.0115 efficiency or reallocate other existing values. These are already scaled final values.

open_findings.problem: The controlled package removes security_state and creates reserve_powers/restricted_public_life, but unresolved_victim_claims appears only on final civilian ratification. Prior victims disappear mechanically during the opening.
open_findings.fix: Retain the same unresolved-victim stage across controlled opening and later handover, without granting it again or treating new abuses as healed.

open_findings.problem: The constitutional_question now ratifies an actual settlement but neither its removes list nor civilian package removes crown_in_exile. The exile-related authority penalty therefore survives a legitimate resolution.
open_findings.fix: Remove crown_in_exile at the actual legitimate constitutional settlement. A royal/republican result must not be predetermined.

open_findings.problem: Civilian officer amnesty in transition_justice can coexist with ND/Centre prosecution legitimacy in institutions. The prose says no opposing reward, but their actual modifier packages occupy different slots and both pay.
open_findings.fix: Make party follow-ups compatible general judicial implementation, or gate/revise the factual justice settlement with replacement and costs. Do not award two opposite dispositions of the same cases. A current stance must not be inferred solely from permanent focus completion.

open_findings.problem: KKE vanguard and executive-royal constitutional changes can retain civilian_order legitimacy and research after abandoning the conditions that enabled that package.
open_findings.fix: Define constitutional mode separately from party selection; replace or disable incompatible parliamentary packages on an actual nonpluralist outcome.

open_findings.problem: Pap/IoA institutional bonuses remain additional to the new regime authority package. This is not illegal syntax, but must be counted and described as distinct compatible benefits rather than duplicate consolidation.
open_findings.fix: Assign authority/legitimacy to the regime slot; restrict party institutional bonuses to a separate implemented policy or deliberately rebalance their cumulative PP and stability.

open_findings.problem: Entrench the Security Directorate gives PP+5% beside an explicit torture grievance. There is no combat reward for torture, but the causal presentation can still imply torture earns authority.
open_findings.fix: Attach any executive-coordination benefit to a separate cabinet mechanism. Coercive practices carry their costs and consequences, with no individual abusive act generating XP, PP, research or production.

numeric_maxima.policy: Permanent positive programme maxima per metric; common sectors plus at most one compatible party. The maximising choices differ by metric. Timed transition costs and unresolved starting penalties are not erased.
numeric_maxima.research_note: No explicit research cap exists in current balance_caps. Either declare 11.5% intentional or reallocate; do not claim it is still 8.5% from the previous review.

current_limits: This is a design graph and proposed documentation helper, not an installed Greek runtime tree. NEW outcome flags still require country-owned domestic transition/election adapters when implementation is authorised.
Reconciliation invocation is presently an explicit integration contract after actual leadership, constitutional and policy changes. The text file alone does not register a game on_action.

Current policy forks are irreversible static X choices, so only one alternative in each current-government slot can have been legitimately granted. If a future revision allows both histories, add current-selection flags; original paid/granted flags alone must not reactivate both.
For future repeated domestic crises, bind current-mandate and outcome flags to the actual current process and clear obsolete authority. Do not treat old focus history as renewed sovereign consent.
A parser pass verifies structural syntax, not game-engine scheduling, tooltip rendering, AI behaviour or focus-completion prerequisite/exclusion bypass. Those require a later in-game test.
Benefits reflect state coordination, openness and implemented institutions. Documentation must continue naming arbitrary detention and torture accurately, with no atrocity action paying a bonus.
